title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #15

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why do we wash our hands before eating? (1 mark)
   A. To waste water
   B. It is only for adults
   C. To make the meal longer
   D. To keep food and ourselves clean

2. Brushing teeth can become an act of worship when you (1 mark)
   A. Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   B. Do it without thinking
   C. Do it to show off
   D. Do it while angry

3. Which time is most important for a child to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Before going to bed
   B. Only after a visit to the dentist
   C. Only after playing
   D. Only on Sunday

4. A game is permitted in Islam if (1 mark)
   A. It uses bad words
   B. It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   C. It involves betting
   D. It hurts people

5. What is a good weekly fitness plan for a child? (1 mark)
   A. Only sweets
   B. No sleep
   C. Sitting all day
   D. About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda

6. Which name of Allah is in every "Bismillah" along with Ar-Rahim? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Ar-Rahman
   C. Al-Malik
   D. Al-Basir

7. Which angel spoke to the Prophet in the cave of Hira? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Atid
   C. Israfil
   D. Mikail

8. Which of these do angels do? (1 mark)
   A. They eat and sleep
   B. They are Allah's daughters
   C. They never disobey Allah
   D. They sometimes disobey

9. What is obedience? (1 mark)
   A. Arguing
   B. Running away
   C. Ignoring orders
   D. Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good

10. Which prophet's story shows a person who refused wrongdoing and feared Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Yusuf
   B. Nuh
   C. Hud
   D. Ilyas

11. Yahya was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Zakariyya
   B. Ibrahim
   C. Musa
   D. Dawud

12. Which is physical purity? (1 mark)
   A. Giving charity
   B. Removing envy from the heart
   C. Saying sorry
   D. Washing off urine from clothes

13. Which is spiritual purity? (1 mark)
   A. Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   B. Washing clothes
   C. Washing hands
   D. Sweeping the room

14. "Taahir" means (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Fasting
   C. Impure
   D. Pure and clean

15. If wudhu breaks during prayer, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Continue
   B. Pray louder
   C. Ignore it
   D. Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again

16. Which of these is recommended before going to sleep? (1 mark)
   A. Make wudhu
   B. Eat a big meal
   C. Shout
   D. Skip prayer

17. Which prayer has three rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Isha
   C. Asr
   D. Maghrib

18. How are the postures of swalah good for health? (1 mark)
   A. They stop movement
   B. They stretch and move the body
   C. They cause sickness
   D. They harm the knees

19. What should you do if you find an injured bird? (1 mark)
   A. Play with it
   B. Kick it
   C. Ignore it
   D. Ask an adult to help

20. What does Qur'an 49:6 tell us about news? (1 mark)
   A. Change it
   B. Ignore it
   C. Check it first
   D. Share it quickly

21. Why should you tell a parent if something online makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. It wastes their time
   B. It is not important
   C. They can protect you
   D. They will laugh

22. What did the Prophet say about cutting and selling firewood? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for the poor
   B. It is shameful
   C. It is better than asking people
   D. It is forbidden

23. When you enter your home after school, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   B. Slam the door
   C. Shout
   D. Sleep

24. What did the Prophet say about being fair among children? (1 mark)
   A. Fear Allah and be fair
   B. Favour the eldest
   C. Favour the youngest
   D. Favour boys

25. Why are children called an amanah? (1 mark)
   A. They are property
   B. They are strangers
   C. They are a trust from Allah
   D. They are servants

26. What did the Prophet say when the angel told him to read? (1 mark)
   A. I am busy
   B. I will read
   C. I cannot read
   D. I am tired

27. What does "Qalam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pen
   B. Book
   C. Sword
   D. Cave

28. What was he called before prophethood? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Farooq
   B. As-Siddiq
   C. Al-Amin
   D. Al-Haqq

29. Who was the first young boy to accept Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Ali
   D. Waraqa

30. Whose protection did the Prophet enter Makkah under after Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Mut'im ibn Adiy
   C. Khalid
   D. Abu Bakr

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State three things that nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

32. How should a Muslim treat a person who asks for help? (4 marks)

33. Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf. (3 marks)

34. State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr. (2 marks)

35. Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house. (3 marks)

36. What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad? (3 marks)

37. State three benefits of saying the duas for leaving and entering the house. (3 marks)

38. Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour. (5 marks)

39. Give three negative uses of media. (3 marks)

40. Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq? (3 marks)

41. How can a child respond politely to a friend who laughs at their modest dress? (3 marks)

42. Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligations? (3 marks)

43. What are angels created from, and what do they never do? (2 marks)

44. Suggest three ways to keep in touch with relatives who live far away. (3 marks)

45. Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir. (3 marks)

46. Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — To keep food and ourselves clean
   Cleanliness is part of good manners and health.

2. A — Intend to follow the Sunnah and stay clean for prayer
   Good intention makes daily acts worship.

3. A — Before going to bed
   Less saliva flows during sleep.

4. B — It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   These are the conditions.

5. D — About 20 minutes of activity daily and water instead of soda
   Regular activity keeps fit.

6. B — Ar-Rahman
   Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim contains both names.

7. A — Jibril
   Jibril came with the first revelation.

8. C — They never disobey Allah
   The Qur'an says they do what they are commanded.

9. D — Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   Obedience is following good commands.

10. A — Yusuf
   Yusuf refused temptation.

11. A — Zakariyya
   Yahya was the son of Zakariyya.

12. D — Washing off urine from clothes
   Physical purity concerns body, clothes and place.

13. A — Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   Repentance and good deeds purify the heart.

14. D — Pure and clean
   Taahir is the opposite of najis.

15. D — Stop, make wudhu and start the prayer again
   Prayer needs valid wudhu.

16. A — Make wudhu
   The Prophet told Al-Bara ibn Azib to do this.

17. D — Maghrib
   Maghrib has three.

18. B — They stretch and move the body
   Regular movement keeps joints flexible.

19. D — Ask an adult to help
   Get help from an adult.

20. C — Check it first
   Verify before acting.

21. C — They can protect you
   Adults can help.

22. C — It is better than asking people
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

23. A — Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   Say dua and greet.

24. A — Fear Allah and be fair
   Fairness among children.

25. C — They are a trust from Allah
   Parents must care for them.

26. C — I cannot read
   He was unlettered.

27. A — Pen
   Allah taught by the pen.

28. C — Al-Amin
   Al-Amin means the trustworthy.

29. C — Ali
   Ali was young and raised in the Prophet's home.

30. B — Mut'im ibn Adiy
   Traditional accounts mention Mut'im.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: With kindness and respect, without driving him away, help if in real need, give quietly, or make a kind reply and dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, remembering Allah, blessings and peace, following the Sunnah, building good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watching harmful content, wasting time, spreading rumours, cyberbullying, unsafe contacts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, explain that they dress that way because of their faith, and do not insult back.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for explaining, 1 mark for not insulting.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Children grow safe and well-behaved, the family and community are strong, and parents earn Allah's reward.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Call, send messages, send gifts, visit in holidays, attend family events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.
